optimizationNotes: Optimization considered only provavel athletes, automatically selected the supported Cartola formation 4-5-1, used current pre-round baselines for the target round, and applied Bayesian shrinkage to penalize athletes with few games played.

athletes.predictionNotes: Expected score (conditional model output weighted by the athlete's estimated play probability) generated from the current pre-round athlete baseline with context derived from local historical Cartola matches, athlete rounds and scouts.
